About FileForge Version %1$s Resumes, cover letters, document scanning, and PDF tools — all in one app. What is FileForge? FileForge is an all-in-one document toolkit: build a professional resume and cover letter, scan paper documents with automatic edge detection, and convert, merge, or compress PDFs — all from your phone, with AI writing help built in. No account, no sign-up required. Core Features Personal Details Name, designation, email, phone, and address. Objective Write or AI-generate a compelling career objective. Education Add multiple education entries with dates and grades. Work Experience Log jobs with AI-improved bullet-point descriptions. Skills Add skills manually or let AI suggest 10 relevant ones. Projects Showcase projects with links and AI-generated summaries. Achievements Highlight awards and accomplishments, AI-assisted. Languages & More Languages, interests, hobbies, and a declaration section. Profile Photo Attach a profile photo and signature directly from your camera or gallery. Cover Letters AI-Tailored Drafting Generate a cover letter tailored to a specific job description, or write one from scratch. Matching Templates Pick a design and export as a polished PDF, just like your resume.

AI-Powered Features The app integrates an AI assistant to help you write and refine resume content. Tap the ✨ sparkle icon inside any supported section to generate or improve text instantly. Objective Generator Writes a professional career objective tailored to your designation. Job Description AI Rewrites work experience bullet points with strong action verbs. Skill Suggestions Suggests 10 relevant skills based on your job role. Project Summaries Generates concise project descriptions from just a project name. Achievement Writer Crafts impactful, quantified achievement statements. AI Chat Assistant Open-ended chat to brainstorm, draft, or refine any part of your resume. Technology Built with Kotlin & Jetpack Compose UI toolkit Material Design 3 Local storage Room (SQLite) — all data stays on your device AI model GPT-OSS 20B AI provider Groq Cloud API (fast inference) PDF export Android WebView → Print API Privacy Your resume data is stored locally on your device using an encrypted database. It is never uploaded or shared with any server. The only time the app accesses the internet is when you use an AI feature — your text prompt is sent to Groq\'s API to generate a response and nothing else is transmitted. Contact & Support Have a question, found a bug, or want to suggest a feature? We\'d love to hear from you. Go to Settings → Write Us to send us an email.
No account required FileForge works without requiring sign-in or an account. Your resumes and cover letters are created and stored locally on your device. Building, editing, previewing, and exporting a resume all work without an internet connection. What\'s stored, and where Everything you enter — personal details, education, work experience, skills, projects, photos, and your signature — is saved in this app\'s private local storage on your device. We do not operate a server that stores your resume content. AI features and what they send Optional AI features — writing suggestions, cover letter generation, the AI assistant, and importing a resume from a PDF or photo — send the relevant text (including text read from an imported file) to Groq, our third-party AI provider, solely to generate a response. This only happens when you actively use an AI feature; it does not happen automatically. Groq processes this data under its own privacy policy (groq.com/privacy). Analytics, crash reporting & ads We use Firebase Analytics and Firebase Crashlytics (Google) to understand feature usage and diagnose crashes, and Google AdMob to show ads, which may use your advertising ID. These services can collect device, usage, and diagnostic data as described in Google\'s privacy policy (policies.google.com/privacy). This does not include the content of your resume or cover letter. Permissions we ask for Camera and photo/file access are used so you can add a profile photo or signature, scan a document, or import an existing resume from a photo or PDF. Files you pick are read only to fill in your resume and are not uploaded anywhere except as described above for AI import. Deleting your data Deleting a resume or cover letter in the app removes it, its photos, and its saved AI assistant conversation from your device. Uninstalling the app removes everything stored locally, since we don\'t keep a server-side copy.
Resume Builder Create a resume From the Home or My Resume tab, tap \"Create Resume\" and enter a name and designation. Fill in your details Open the resume and work through each section — Personal Details, Objective, Education, Work Experience, Skills, and more. Add a photo or signature Use the Profile Photo and Signature sections to capture or pick an image. Choose a template Tap the palette icon to pick from several professional designs — switching templates never loses your entered data. Preview and download Tap the eye icon to see exactly how your resume will look, then tap the print icon to save it as a PDF or print it.
Cover Letters Create a cover letter From Home, tap \"Cover Letter\" to start one from scratch or let AI draft one tailored to a job description. Choose a template Pick a design from the template picker — you can switch anytime without losing what you\'ve written. Preview and export Tap preview to check the layout, then share or download it as a PDF.
Document Scanner Scan a document From Home, tap \"Scan Document\" and capture a page — edges are detected and cropped automatically. Review and edit text Extracted text for each page is editable, so you can fix anything OCR misread. Save or share Save the scan as a PDF or share it directly — everything scanned is also kept under \"My Scanned Documents\".
PDF Tools Pick a tool From Home, tap \"Convert Files\" to turn images into a PDF, merge multiple PDFs, compress a large PDF, or convert a PDF\'s pages to JPGs. Select files and convert Choose your file(s), give the result a name, and download it once it\'s ready.
AI Assistant Get writing help in any section Look for the AI sparkle button inside Objective, Work Experience, Skills, Projects, and Achievements to improve or generate wording. Ask the AI Chat Tap \"Ask AI Assistant\" on Home for open-ended help — resume advice, interview prep, or general questions.
